diagnosis: The user provisioning endpoint connects to the dedicated PostgreSQL pool of tenantId from the URL path and inserts new users (including admin roles) without checking if the caller is an administrator of that tenant. Any authenticated user can provision accounts and backdoor administrator access in other companies' tenant databases.
